notes.title: Character Select is Live: Choose Your Runner
notes.content: [p]Harder Parkour now lets you choose your runner.[/p][p]Female and Male characters are available with updated animations and smoother movement flow.[/p][p][b]What’s New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Character Select menu[/p][/*][*][p]Female and Male avatars[/p][/*][/list][p]Which runner do you prefer? Share your thoughts and your favorite character with us, your feedback will help shape the next updates.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="nFObhOBgmWU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Thanks for being with us from the start![/p][p]-Team Harder Parkour[/p]

notes.title: First Look at Harder Parkour: New Gameplay Footage!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re excited to share the very first gameplay video of Harder Parkour! This update gives you a glimpse into the wild, abstract universe of the game, where every move is a test of precision and momentum.[/p][p][/p][p]This is your first look at the parkour driven journey ahead, a place shaped by physics, reflex, and resolve. It’s just the beginning, and we’re still tuning movement, animation, and the visual atmosphere.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="yGGH58DMlbo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Thanks for being with us from the start![/p][p]-Team Harder Parkour[/p]
